name: Beef and Olive Tagine with Preserved Lemon
description: A Moroccan beef tagine with green olives, preserved lemon, saffron, and waxy potatoes. Cooked using French braising discipline. Halal, no alcohol.
keywords: halal french cooking, beef tagine, olive tagine, preserved lemon, moroccan beef
recipeIngredient: 500 g lean halal beef, cut into 4 cm chunks
700 g waxy potatoes, peeled and cut into wedges
1 handful fresh flat-leaf parsley or coriander

recipeInstructions.text: Bloom the saffron threads in 2 tbsp warm water for 10 minutes.
Warm olive oil in a heavy-bottomed pot over medium heat. Cook the sliced onion until soft and translucent, about 7 minutes.
Add garlic, ginger, turmeric, black pepper, and salt. Stir for 90 seconds until fragrant.
Add beef chunks and turn to coat. Cook over medium-high heat for 5 minutes until the exterior loses its raw colour.
Pour in the water and bloomed saffron. Add whole chilli if using. Bring to a simmer, reduce to low-medium.
Cover tightly and braise for 20 minutes at a gentle simmer.
Add potato wedges and olives. Stir gently, replace lid, cook for 15 more minutes.
Add preserved lemon rind pieces. Cook uncovered for 10 minutes to reduce the sauce slightly.
Taste for salt, remove chilli, rest off heat for 5 minutes.
Scatter chopped parsley or coriander over the top and serve with flatbread.
